name: Контратака (2)
description:
Another lesson about counterattacking. Once again, we are going to launch a counterattack on a piece or on the king. A great trick to prevent losses.

We are now focussing on the second move. The counterattack enables White to defend. It is good to be aware of that. Look at the examples to see what we mean by this.

Example 1 shows a counterattack plus moving away.
Example 2 shows a counterattack plus capturing.
Example 3 shows a counterattack plus protecting.

Did you notice? Counterattacks are followed by one of the familiar defenses. Blocking is, of course, also one of them.

What do you have to do?
Defend a piece by using a good counterattack. On the second move, weigh your defense options. Think about all familiar means of defending: moving away, protecting, capturing and blocking.

examples.pgn: {[%cal Gg6f6,Gg6h6,Gd6e5] [%csl Rg4]} 1. Bc2+ Kf7 {[%csl Gh6]} 2. Nh6+ *
examples.text:
The knight cannot flee. Either Black’s pawn or Black’s king will take. But there’s no need for White to defend his knight straight away. His bishop can check Black’s king, first. The king needs to step back.

Now, the position has changed. Before, the king guarded two squares and now only one. White can save his knight by moving it to the green square.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Rg4][%cal Gd3f5]} 1. Nb2 Qa6 {[%csl Gf5]} 2. Qxf5 *
examples.text:
Things look glum for the white rook. It can’t flee. Taking the attacking pawn is not an option either. Black’s queen protects this little attacker.

White decides to launch a counterattack: the knight threatens the queen! Black won’t take the rook now, because it would cost him his queen. And a queen is more valuable.

Black moves his queen into safety. That is good news for White (take a look at the moves). The black pawn has lost his mighty defender. White’s queen can safely capture it.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Rh2]} 1. Bb5+ Kb7 {[%csl Gf1]} 2. Nf1 {[%cal Gb5f1]} *
examples.text:
How is White to defend his knight? By checking Black’s king with his bishop!
Black cannot capture because he needs to get out of check first. The black king moves. Look at the position! Now, there is a safe square for the knight, guarded by the bishop.

texts: Find a way to save your knight.
